newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Chiwan 96 net dips 14 pct.
newsitem.headline: China Chiwan 96 net dips 14 pct.

text.p: (in millions of yuan unless stated, against 1995 figures)
Earnings per share 0.281 yuan vs 0.326 yuan
Net assets per share 2.52 yuan vs 2.41 yuan
Company name: Chiwan Wharf Holdings Ltd.
NOTE: The results, calculated under international accounting standards, were published in a statement in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times on Tuesday.
Chiwan's board of directors proposed a cash dividend of 0.169 yuan per share from the 1996 profit, pending the approval of shareholders at an annual general meeting on May 10, the statement said.

Shareholders will also vote on a plan to make a two-for-10 rights offer, tentatively priced at between 4.5 yuan and 6.0 yuan per share. Proceeds will be used to expand port facilities, the statement said.
